page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one column of running text, with a marginal reference at the left beside the Hosea quotation and the catchword at the bottom right. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with fragments of about 30 cut-off lines and no readable margin notes.

main_text.p: tiam sanctificationis, id est, gratiam pro gra-tia. Quod si ex Christi plenitudine accipimus vocationem, iustificationem, sanctificationem: hum quis est, qui hæc omnia ad passivam obedientiam referet? iustificatio, & sanctificatio ex cius plenitudine, quid est nisi idipsum, ꝗ docuit Apostolus, Christum à Deo factū nobis iustitiam, & sanctificationem. Ita iustitia, & sanctificatio imputantur nobis, non tantū obedientia passiua. Deinde qui iustificationem in remissione peccatorum ita statuunt, ut iustitiam Christi imputatam negent, & sponsam Christi nudam relinquunt sine ornamentis, & sponsalibus gemmis. Nam peccatorum remissio turpitudinem quidem aufert, sed non pulchritudinem illam, miroretq; præstat nobis qui diuinum fauorem deducat nobis, & conciliat. Propter peccata mea dimissa, non iam habet Deus in me quod iram eius, & odiū prouocet, sed nec habet inde, quod diligat. Et quid mihi proderit peccatorum meorum remissio, nisi & Dei fauorem ac dilectionem obtineam? vt ergo in sanguine Christi, atque in morte eius peccatorum remissionem habemus, sic in iustitia Christi, & sanctificatione, sponsa Christi sua habet ornamenta & monilia quibus & fauor Dei, & amor sponsi cóci-liatur. De quibus sponsalibus ornamentis legimus apud Hoseam Prophetā: Hos. 2. 19.Et sponsabo te mihi in sempiternū, & sponsabo te mihi in iustitia, & in iudicio, & in misericordia, & in miserationibus, & sponsabo te mihi in fide, & scies quia ego Dominus. page.notes: The scan is cropped at the right edge of the left page. The right page is cut off, so only fragments of its lines show, and those fragments are given as partial lines, not as full text. The Hosea reference is in the left margin. Doubtful readings: "miroretq;", "obtineam" (the line-end is read as "obti-" with a [?] reading), "cóci-", and the abbreviation "ꝗ" for quod, which should be checked against the scan. Long s has been normalised to s; u and v are normalised where a consonant or vowel is clear. Show-through and the neighbouring page edge are not transcribed.
